title: Miami at Notre Dame Headlines a Saturday Full of Ranked Matchups
dek: Top-ranked, unbeaten Miami visits No. 11 Notre Dame in prime time, one of six games this Saturday that pit ranked teams against each other in the first College Football Playoff rankings push.
author: Meridian Newsroom

image.alt: View of the football stadium at the University of Notre Dame from premium seating

keyPoints: No. 1 Miami, unbeaten, plays at No. 11 Notre Dame in prime time, a game The Athletic called the week's marquee matchup.
Six games match ranked teams from the College Football Playoff committee's first 2026 rankings, released Nov. 3.
Utah (8-0, No. 3) hosts BYU (7-1, No. 9) at noon Eastern on ABC.
Alabama at LSU and Kentucky at Tennessee are among the other ranked matchups on the card.
body:
Saturday is the biggest day of the college football regular season so far, and the first full slate played since the College Football Playoff selection committee released its initial 2026 rankings.

## The marquee game

The night's headliner is top-ranked, unbeaten Miami at No. 11 Notre Dame. The Athletic's week-10 preview called it the game of the week and noted that Notre Dame probably needs a win to stay in playoff contention. Miami's unbeaten record makes it the team the rest of the field has to chase.

## Ranked against ranked

Vanderbilt Report's schedule of the day lists six games between ranked teams from the committee's top 25. Its listed kickoffs, in Eastern time and subject to change, include:

- Noon: No. 9 BYU at No. 3 Utah in Salt Lake City, with Utah at 8-0 and BYU at 7-1, on ABC.
- Noon: No. 7 Texas at No. 18 Missouri in Columbia, on ESPN.
- 3:30 p.m.: No. 5 Alabama at No. 14 LSU in Baton Rouge, on ABC.
- 6:15 p.m.: No. 6 Kentucky at No. 13 Tennessee in Knoxville, on ESPN.
- Evening: Georgia's ranked road game at Ole Miss, also on the day's schedule.

The Athletic also highlighted the Week 10 slate beyond the top games, including Air Force at Army at 7:30 p.m. on CBS, which decides the Commander-in-Chief's Trophy, and No. 19 Iowa at Northwestern at 7:30 p.m. on Fox.

## Why it matters

The committee's first rankings put a premium on wins over ranked opponents. Vanderbilt Report noted that five of the committee's top seven teams play ranked opponents on Saturday, so the day could reshape the 12-team playoff field. Utah, which is chasing a first-round bye, would strengthen its case with a win over BYU in the Holy War, the first as head coach for Morgan Scalley.

## Results

This preview reflects the published schedule and rankings as of Saturday afternoon. Results for games already underway, and any ranking changes, were not verified for this story and will be added in a later update once confirmed by the schools or official box scores.
